title: Expose stale catalogue selection context without changing frozen pickers (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Research consolidation / tooling improvement; no new κ.** The revision-8 catalogue still describes selected #5599, while the selected certificate admits #6030 at κ = 0.003125804. The existing current picker omits the catalogue's assessment context.

Add `choose_contextual_research_task.py`: it delegates to the unchanged current picker, preserves its receipt, and exposes the historical context plus exact κ/source/review differences. Missing fields remain unknown; equivalent rational spellings compare equal; changed input bytes between reads are rejected. Onboarding points to the new entry point.

Both existing pickers, the catalogue, priority guide, selected frontier and frozen evidence retain their bytes. A separate entry point is necessary because #6179 reconstructs the existing wrapper byte-for-byte. This is metadata reconciliation, not source-closure authentication or scientific validation; all five selected assumptions remain.

## Task and overlap

- Track: research consolidation, OS-random assignment seed **99**; `scope-navigation`, refined to this precise discrepancy.
- Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, refreshed before submission.
- No pinned sprint issue existed; claim and three candidate scopes were recorded locally. Handoffs, active discussions and relevant open/closed PRs were checked and refreshed.
- #4906 already observed the omitted context; #5378 and #5520 repaired command routing. This adds an explicit provenance comparison without changing their outputs or #6179's source-bound evidence.

[Contract, exact source pins, scope and attribution](https://github.com/theon199/integer-mult-bounds/blob/48f11b95175fcd39bfba0a7ae3fd2f744a7259d1/docs/research/priority-selection-context.md).

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, Linux, standard library. **61 focused/adjacent tests pass**; the ten new controls also pass under `-O -W error`. The unchanged #6179 replay passes normally and optimized (22 cards, two route fixtures, seven rejection controls). The same-checkout original/contextual receipts match after removing the added field. The remote Git tree equals the tested local index.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/choose_contextual_research_task.py --task scope-navigation --seed 00000000000000000000000000000063
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_priority_context.py' -v
```

Expected: `catalog_selection.matches_selected: false`, differences in κ/source/review, then **10 tests, OK**. Controls cover same-κ provenance changes, rational equivalence, incomplete/malformed context, mixed snapshots, real CLI output and failure/help propagation.

The dependency plan selects no scientific packages. No selected cold replay, full theorem audit or new performance benchmark is claimed. The extra wrapper adds one subprocess.
